title_en: Stories of Modern China (8/20): The Well That Remembers
note_en: Chinese can ask a yes-no question by putting a verb side by side with its negative instead of adding 吗: Doudou asks 这口井会不会也记得您呀？ "Does the well remember you too?" English inverts the word order ("Does it…?"), while Chinese keeps statement order and just offers both options, 会 or 不会. The question particle 呀 at the end softens it, which suits a child talking to his grandmother.
